library.title: GALIL house style — quick rules
library.body: Sentence case for headings. Second person for procedures. No future tense in steps. Israeli date format everywhere.

library.title: Screenshot capture checklist
library.body: 1366×768 window. Hide personal data. PNG, 96 dpi. Crop to the control plus one container.

library.title: IFU wording — regulatory notes
library.body: Use the client's approved warning phrases verbatim. Every change to an alarm description goes through regulatory review.
